title: D-034: ARCHITECTURE.md (six-question context) + repo-local /pr-review skill
objective: Implement D-034-R001..R004: (1) repo-root ARCHITECTURE.md answering exactly the six captured questions for THIS system (what exists; who owns what; what may depend on what incl. explicit FORBIDDEN paths; how data moves with provenance; what must stay true - the invariants incl. AI-never-calculates, deterministic-code-never-guesses-sources, fail-safe-never-fabricates, orchestrator-only git/ledger; when an agent must STOP: boundary-breaking tasks stop-explain-impact-smallest-change), concise, only what is hard to infer safely, consistent with CLAUDE.md and path-scoped rules WITHOUT duplicating them; (2) .claude/skills/pr-review/SKILL.md - /pr-review [branch|target] reviewing a diff for code quality, test adequacy, security, and contract/backward compatibility PLUS repo-specific provenance discipline and fail-safe correctness, output = only actionable problems each with code pointer + failure scenario, unverifiable items explicitly UNPROVEN, and a closing citation that ledger DONE comes only from gates/evidence (never from this skill); (3) both artifacts cite the existing evidence-before-DONE law rather than duplicating it.
business_reason: Owner directive D-034 (captured practice screenshots): make architectural intent explicit instead of forcing agents to infer it; give every session a repo-tuned review skill.
acceptance_scenarios: S1 six questions: ARCHITECTURE.md has exactly the six sections, each answering ONLY what is hard to infer safely; every named component/flow/boundary verifiably exists in the repo (reviewer spot-checks); no duplication of CLAUDE.md or path-scoped rule text.

S2 forbidden paths + invariants: the dependency section documents the real forbidden edges (e.g. frontend never touches Supabase service keys; connectors never write the ledger; workers never run git; AI never computes legal values) and the invariants section states each with its enforcing mechanism.
S3 stop conditions: the STOP section gives the exact stop-explain-impact-smallest-change protocol and names the boundary classes that trigger it.

S4 skill correctness: /pr-review skill reviews an arbitrary diff target for the six dimensions (4 captured + provenance + fail-safe), demands only-actionable output with code pointers and failure scenarios, marks unverifiable items UNPROVEN, and explicitly disclaims ledger authority (advisory; gates decide DONE).
S5 trial run: the producer report contains one real trial invocation of the skill instructions against a recent real diff (e.g. commit f12e828c) demonstrating the output discipline.
path_free_justification: All three deliverables are NEW files not present at contract time; no production code in scope; identity binds once committed and gated.
